links.outcome: Overestimation of model performance from internal validation due to shortcut learning of data acquisition biases
links.effect: Model performance frequently overestimated by up to 20% on average across 13 datasets due to shortcut learning of hidden data acquisition biases.
links.quote: In experiments across 13 datasets including X-rays, CTs, ECGs, clinical discharge summaries, and lung auscultation data, our results demonstrate that model performance is frequently overestimated by up to 20% on average due to shortcut learning of hidden data acquisition biases (DAB).

unlisted_practices: Bias-corrected external accuracy estimate (P_Est) that measures and calibrates for data acquisition bias shortcut learning to estimate external performance without external data

screen.reason: The study develops and tests an empirical validation method (P_Est) to estimate external model generalizability and adjust for shortcut learning/data acquisition biases across multiple multimodal health datasets prior to external deployment.

primary.practice: local validation / pre-deployment external accuracy estimation method
